text:
elaine: Quick ops thread — international webinar tomorrow 10:00 UTC (EMEA focus). Need owners for: registration page UX + accessibility check, Zoom config + recording targets, S3 handoff + transcript flow, and post-event follow-up (hubspot tags + nurture). Who can take what? :spiral_calendar:

sam: I can own the registration page copy + hidden fields for tracking. Will run an a11y sweep and add aria labels. ETA: EOD today. :white_check_mark:

ryan: I’ll take Zoom. Planning to set cloud recording to only "active speaker + shared screen" and enable alternative host for standby. Also will enable auto-transcript. Need the S3 path and credentials for handoff.

elaine: S3 path for this event: s3://redwood-internal/webinars/2024-05-01-intl. Ryan — do NOT share creds here. I’ll create a short-lived role and add you. Also please enable local fallback (participants can upload) and RTMP fallback to our streaming account.

ryan: Got it. Zoom settings I’ll apply (pasting what I plan):
```
Cloud Recording: enabled
Recording Layout: Active Speaker, Shared Screen (side-by-side off)
Auto-Transcription: enabled -> Save as .vtt and .txt
Alternative Host: @elaine
Authentication: Only authenticated users from allowed domains
RTMP fallback: redwood-streaming-prod
```

sam: For the reg page I’ll add these hidden inputs: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, campaign_id. Also adding an a11y note "captions available; request live captioning" and a timezone selector (default to user local).

sam: HubSpot mapping plan in short: registration -> create contact; if utm_campaign contains "intl-webinar" then add Contact Property "webinar_2024-05-01" = true and add to list "Intl Webinar Attendees". Zapier -> hubspot-create-or-update -> set owner = marketing team inbox for now.

elaine: Nice. Ryan — after recording ends, can you set up the upload to the S3 path and trigger the transcript job (auto-translate pipeline)? We want captions + English transcript published to Notion for edit within 2 business days.

ryan: Yep. I’ll wire the post-recording Lambda: zoom->s3 -> step function kicks off transcript & snippet generator. Quick snippet of the post-recording webhook body I’ll use for the lambda: 
```json
{
  "meeting_id": "<zoom_meeting_id>",
  "recording_files": ["audio.mp4","share_screen.mp4"],
  "s3_destination": "s3://redwood-internal/webinars/2024-05-01-intl"
}
```

elaine: Perfect. Sam — can you draft the 3-email follow-up cadence (replay + highlights + CTA) and share the copy in the #marketing-docs drive before EOD? We'll want one focused on APAC-friendly send time too.

sam: On it. Drafting now, will ping when uploaded. Also adding a quick reply template for registrants who ask for captions / accessibility.

marketing-bot: Reminder scheduled: pre-webinar checklist ping 30m before start to @channel.

elaine: Thanks team — can we do a final sync 30m before the event in this thread? Quick confirm once your pieces are done. :pray:
